BEN.note: Minister's remarks on AI sovereignty state no rule, draft or authority on AI harms.
Only AI technical advisers placed in ministries are described; no AI system in use or piloted in administration is stated.
No AI tool in a sector's public system is stated; only online visa and criminal record services, which are not AI.
Minister is described as in charge of the national AI strategy and defends an approach, but the document gives no draft, adoption, named body tied to it or funding.
Local tools and computing capacity are called a need; no model, dataset or AI computing built or planned with a named builder is stated.
Document does not mention police station records.
